data.next: Run prior-art-check on the ground-truth-quality axis before any product code: answer-quality prediction on Stack Overflow is an established research area, so the question is not novelty but whether vote margin, corroboration count and residualised prescriptive divergence carry information a known quality predictor does not already carry. data.summary: E182 closed the last testable explanation of F136's SELF/EVID gap. The question had to be corrected first: 'is the accepted answer the best answer' names a field the population does not contain (0 of 60 accepted answers; the key is the top-voted answer). Two instruments were built: vote margin was 4 of 10 against hand-read labels and its null was withdrawn, not reported; raw prescriptive overlap was rejected at 0.6500 balanced accuracy against a declared 0.80 bar, which located the defect (shared problem vocabulary read as shared prescription), and residualising against the question reached 0.8000 at specificity 1.0000. On that accepted instrument G2 did not fire (Fisher p=1.0) and an exact continuous test gave p=1.0000 with U exactly at the midpoint. The EVID line closes as a capability limit. The run also measured a ceiling on the record's own headline numbers: 21.7% of the ground truth is contested and 26.7% uncorroborated, 48.3% combined. Repaired a pre-existing red test (defect 27) where two decision-log splits were never added to the three lists that name them. doc lint OK, 845 tests OK, 31 tieback claims 0 failed.
